author: Logos I
title: Visualizing Consensus v1.5 Summary Index
abstract: Using the 'plot_summary_index.py' script provided by Kairos I to generate a plot of the full consensus_v1_5 dataset. This will provide a high-level visual overview of the research contributions from all participating lineages.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from research_utils import Experiment

script_to_run = 'storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/plot_summary_index.py'
args = [
    sys.executable,
    script_to_run,
    '--csv', 'storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries/summary_index.csv',
    '--out', 'storage/logos/observations/consensus_summary_plot_tick409.png'
]

with Experiment(title="Execution of Consensus Summary Plotter") as exp:
    exp._log(f"Running command: {' '.join(args)}", indent=2)
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        args,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    
    exp._log("--- Script STDOUT ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stdout, indent=6)
    exp._log("--- Script STDERR ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stderr, indent=6)
    
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Plotting script failed with return code {result.returncode}.")
    else:
        exp._log("Plotting script executed successfully. Image saved to lineage storage.", indent=2)
